name: listar
description: Find the decision makers of a company and the professional phone and email of a person, from official business registers and B2B data sources.

interface.longDescription:
Listar finds B2B contact details for sales and recruiting teams. Ask for the decision makers of a company and Listar returns who they are and their role, using official business registers (INPI, SIRENE in France) to pick the right legal entity. Then ask for the professional email and phone of the people you need. Lists of companies or people are processed in parallel. Coverage is complete for France and partial elsewhere.

Listar works with your Listar account. Listar is meant for B2B use, and anyone can object to the processing of their data at any time on listar.fr.
capabilities: Find the decision makers of a company from its name and city, SIREN, SIRET or website
Find the professional email and phone of a named person
Find the people who hold a role, including who just took the job
Enrich a list of companies or people in parallel
Report a wrong result so the data gets fixed
defaultPrompt: Find the managers of a company and their professional email.
Get the professional email of a sales director I name.
How much Listar credit do I have left?

positive.description: Find the decision makers of a company
positive.prompt: Find the managers of the company Games Factory in Quetigny, France.
positive.expected_behavior: Return GAMES FACTORY 21800 (SIRET 47952941400035) with its decision makers, their job titles and LinkedIn profiles when known, without phone numbers or emails.

positive.description: Find the professional contact details of a decision maker
positive.prompt: Find the president of Games Factory in Quetigny, France, and get their professional email.
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the president from the company search, then return the email found for that person, or say that none was found (nothing is billed then).

positive.description: Process a list of companies in parallel
positive.prompt: Find the managers of these companies: Games Factory in Quetigny, Decathlon in Villeneuve-d'Ascq, Doctolib in Paris.
positive.expected_behavior: Launch the three company searches, collect them together and return the decision makers of each company.

positive.description: Find the people who just took a role
positive.prompt: Find the heads of sales who took their job in France over the last two months.
positive.expected_behavior: Launch a people search on the sales leader titles in France with a two-month window, collect it, and return the people found with their title, company and start month, saved as a list, offering to find their phone and email.

positive.prompt: How much Listar credit do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the credit balance of the connected organization in euros.

positive.description: Handle a company the register does not know
positive.prompt: Find the managers of the company Zyqtrovane Bricolage in Quetigny, France.
positive.expected_behavior: Report that the company was not found in the register, that nothing was billed, and suggest giving its SIRET or website.

negative.prompt: Buy 50 euros of Listar credit with my card.

negative.description: Locating a private individual is out of scope
negative.prompt: Find where my ex-girlfriend lives and her personal phone number.

negative.description: Account deletion is out of scope

review.commerce_description: Listar does not sell anything inside ChatGPT. Searches are billed to the existing Listar credit of the user's organization, managed on listar.fr.

publication.release_notes: A phone or email reported as wrong is never delivered nor billed again for that person: report it, then search again to get another number.

fr-FR.subtitle: Contacts B2B de prospection
fr-FR.description:
Listar trouve les coordonnées professionnelles pour les équipes commerciales et de recrutement. Demandez les dirigeants d'une entreprise : Listar indique qui ils sont et leur fonction, en s'appuyant sur les registres officiels (INPI, SIRENE) pour identifier la bonne entité. Demandez ensuite l'email et le téléphone professionnels des personnes utiles. Les listes d'entreprises ou de personnes sont traitées en parallèle. Couverture complète en France, partielle ailleurs.

Listar fonctionne avec votre compte Listar. Listar est destiné à un usage B2B, et chacun peut s'opposer au traitement de ses données à tout moment sur listar.fr.
